note: Regional park on the Saskatchewan River (the river section of Tobin Lake) 2 km from Nipawin, with forested loops of birch, pine and tamarack, a fish pond, dual boat launch and marina, mini golf, spray park and a barnyard zoo. About half the sites are seasonal. ATVs, dirt bikes and golf carts are not allowed in the park. --Claude
